### rigidValve2d

This example implements the model for predicting the dynamic response of a mechanical heart valve as described by Stijnen *et al.* [@stijnen2004].

![Exemplary time step portraying the physical velocity in the example `rigidValve2d`.](/examples/fsi/rigidValve2d/doc/fig/rigidValve2d.png){#fig-rigidValve2D width="90%"}
